endorsements.name: Kees Cook
endorsements.label: Kernel Exploitation Via Uninitialized Stack
endorsements.description: Leveraging uninitialized stack memory into a full-blown root escalation is easier than it sounds. See how to find these vulnerabilities, avoid the pitfalls of priming the stack, and turn your "memory corruption" into full root privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 19
